title: Local finite-sum kernel models for Hom out of a coherent module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal G$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $\mathcal F$ any $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every point $x\in X$ there are an open neighbourhood $U\ni x$, integers $m,n\geq0$, and an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map $\alpha:(\mathcal F|_U)^{\oplus n}\to(\mathcal F|_U)^{\oplus m}$ such that $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)|_U\cong\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha)$ as $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The sums are finite categorical biproducts, including the empty sum when a rank is zero, and restrictions are along the open immersion $U\hookrightarrow X$. No coherence or Noetherian assumption is imposed on $\mathcal F$ or $X$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BW (lemma-coherent-finite-presentation); Lemma 01CQ (lemma-internal-hom-locally-kernel-direct-sum), first assertion; proof of Lemma 01CP (lemma-stalk-internal-hom).

proof.text: Apply coherent_local_finite_presentation to G and x, obtaining a neighbourhood V, ranks m,n, a map a and a cokernel isomorphism e.

Apply homObj_locally_kernel_of_local_presentation to this specified a and e on V, with target F. It supplies alpha and its kernel isomorphism on V. Use x in V to assemble the required existential witnesses.

lean.statement: theorem homObj_locally_kernel_of_coherent (X : Scheme.{u}) (G F : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) (x : X) : ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧ ∃ (m n : ℕ) (α : (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ F.restrict U.ι) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin m ↦ F.restrict U.ι)), Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) G F) ≅ kernel α)
